pericopes.title: The Shepherd
pericopes.imageAlt: Bright pale shoots of low grass beside a still shallow pool reflecting late afternoon sky, a faint trodden path leading toward the water

pericopes.title: In the Valley
pericopes.imageAlt: A narrow worn path threading between two weathered stone walls in deep shadow, with a single sharp blade of late golden light cutting across the far end

pericopes.title: At the Table
